verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents per-send bounce, complaint, or blocklist reporting, or any guidance when deliverability degrades. Dedicated IPs are a related deliverability feature, and the generic KPI dashboards do not show these signals or remediation advice, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
